# Your Puzzle Source

> > Your Puzzle Source is a comprehensive platform offering free online puzzles including sudoku, crosswords, word search, and jigsaw games designed for brain health and entertainment.

Your Puzzle Source provides daily and weekend puzzle games created by Phil Fraas and Alexis Olson. The site combines free playable puzzle content with published puzzle books and custom solutions for businesses seeking branded puzzle marketing.

## Key Topics

- Free Online Puzzles
- Daily Crossword
- Sudoku
- Word Search
- Jigsaw Puzzles
- Mini Crosswords
- Weekend Crossword

- Brain Health

## Puzzle Games

- [Daily Crossword](https://yourpuzzlesource.com/puzzles/daily-crossword): Daily crossword puzzle game with new puzzles Monday-Friday
- [Weekend Crossword](https://yourpuzzlesource.com/puzzles/weekend-crossword): Weekend crossword puzzle game with mini-crosswords
- [Sudoku](https://yourpuzzlesource.com/puzzles/sudoku): Free online sudoku puzzle game with daily content
- [Word Search](https://yourpuzzlesource.com/puzzles/word-search): Free online word search puzzle game
- [Jigsaw](https://yourpuzzlesource.com/puzzles/jigsaw): Free online jigsaw puzzle game with printable options
